scope: Finite authored simulation and actual deterministic software execution; no real material, buyer, certification, money or industrial actuation
objective: Test whether a source-bound remnant inventory and accepted cut plan can connect two voluntary material-fulfillment opportunities through one native account
selected_constraint: Cross-order material reuse needs explicit dimensions, grades, source identities, exactly-once stock use and costed handover, not just a low trim-loss objective
known_alternatives: Exact ordinary mixed-integer cutting-stock optimization with identical inventory and terms
Equal-content ordinary reuse of the exact same inventory and artifact
Direct virgin stock plus self-service cutting
first_input: Published mathematical optimization tutorial: roll width 9, lengths/counts 2:4,3:2,4:6,5:6,6:2,7:2,8:2. Integer mm conversion is authored. This is a textbook instance, not an industrial measurement.
comparisons: candidate exact finite dynamic programming versus independent ordinary MILP
successor with first-cycle remnants versus strongest registered virgin-stock route without those remnants
cost_scope: All modeled material, cutting, shipping, production, source checking, acquisition, construction/search/unsuccessful tests, maintenance, payment fees and 20 percent positive-profit tax provision. Host/model/developer actual billing remains unknown.
stopping: Execute one first order and one newly observed successor from one fresh isolated account; retain no-purchase/adverse comparisons; independently check conservation, native audit, collected revenue and residual obligations. Stop after terminal decision and compact receipt. Do not annualize or scale buyer counts.
residual_title: Pieces-only fulfillment: supplier retains offcuts. Central buyer has zero realizable outside salvage bid; compare a 70 USD salvage bid that can defeat the offer. This is an authored market assumption, not physical worthlessness or consent.
qualification_note: Development comparison; zero-kerf textbook and finite authored prices, not untouched industrial holdout.
